articles.summary: − Company to present Phase 2 clinical data evaluating SLS009 (tambiciclib) in combination with azacitidine and venetoclax in patients who have previously failed venetoclax-based therapy − − Patients with relapsed/refractory monocytic AML achieved a 54% ORR with a median overall survival (mOS) of 5.8 months and patients with TP53-mutated AML achieved a 57% ORR and a mOS of 8.8 months, comparing favorably to historical outcomes in these adverse-risk settings of ~2.5 months − − Study showed that SLS009 (tambiciclib) combination was well-tolerated with no meaningful added toxicity − NEW YORK, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SELLAS Life Sciences Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: SLS) (“SELLAS” or the “Company”), a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel therapies for a broad range of cancer indications, today announced that data from its completed Phase 2 study of SLS009 (tambiciclib) for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute
articles.title: SELLAS Life Sciences to Present Positive Phase 2 Data Demonstrating Encouraging Response and Survival Outcomes with SLS009 Combination in High-Risk AML at ASH 2026
